comments.text: Matt parker made a video a few years ago about mail-in voting and the red mirage/blue shift. That was when I learned that the count doesn't conclude for about a month. The results we see first are a statistical victory based off of the ratio of votes received, followed by a mathematical victory about a week later, which is when the number of votes the loser would need to win is larger than the number of uncounted ballots, then finally the official victory once all ballots are counted. Learning that puts calls to "Stop the count" in a different light when you realize that the count doesn't stop until December.
